summary: Iteration 4: membership levels. Backend: new tests/test_nocturne_membership.py with 11 tests, all passing. Full suite 64/64 passing (pytest -n 0). Tests cover plans, upgrade 400s (unknown level, same level, business account), level in /auth/me, 403 '<Level> membership required' for gold/silver venue reservations, gold event tickets and gold partner bookings, success after upgrade, fees of 25/20/15%, ticket discounts of 10/20% with a 15% fee on the discounted base, simulated membership_payments (free_girl bronze = $0), partner categories, unknown category 400, more than 180 days 400, admin members_by_level and the CSV level column. Frontend at 375x667, all requested flows pass: sign-up tier step (6 testIDs; picking Gold gives a Gold profile badge); lock badges on home event cards, venue cards and luxe partner cards; locked gold event/venue/partner screens show unlock-*-btn and it goes to /membership; membership screen switch gold->silver updates CURRENT and membership-msg; partner detail shows Public rate, partner-savings and a tier-specific fee label (Bronze 25%, Silver 20%); silver event shows a discount row ($40 -> $41.40 is correct); compose saved twice sends POST then PUT, leaving 1 article with the edit applied (AI draft not called). Deprecated packages detected: none.

ui_bugs.issue: After a downgrade (gold->silver or ->bronze) the message still says 'You're now Silver. Enjoy the upgrade.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/membership.tsx:32

A free_girl user who paid for Gold or Silver is shown 'GOLD MEMBER · LADIES FREE'. That reads as if Gold is free. The perk label should only show at Bronze level, or say 'Ladies (Bronze free)'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx:90

integration_issues.issue: api.upgrade(level).catch(() => {}) swallows errors. If the upgrade fails, the user lands on Bronze with no feedback. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(auth)/sign-up.tsx:66

issues: Touch targets under 44pt: profile-level-badge is 214x25 and manage-membership-btn is 129x23. Add hitSlop or minHeight 44.
units-plus/units-minus can sit under the sticky footer on a 667px-tall screen. Content paddingBottom should be at least the sticky footer height so the controls can scroll clear of it.

action_items: membership.tsx:32 - use 'upgrade' or 'downgrade' wording based on the level rank
profile.tsx:90 - show the free_girl/trial_male perk suffix only when level is bronze
sign-up.tsx:66 - don't silently swallow upgrade errors; tell the user if the paid tier was not applied
Add hitSlop or minHeight 44 to profile-level-badge and manage-membership-btn
server.py is 715 lines (over the 700 limit); move the auth/tickets/reservations routers into modules
critical_code_review_comments: Backend gating (require_level) is applied in all three booking paths, and fees use user_level. Admin/venue_owner are treated as gold. All correct.
event/[id].tsx calculates the fee on the unrounded discounted base while the backend rounds base first. A 1 cent display difference is possible for some prices.

Compose: after router.setParams({id}) the admin-articles query is enabled and its useEffect resets the form fields from the server copy. If an admin types during that refetch, the edits could be overwritten. Minor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 2 low-priority copy issues, 1 silent-error issue, touch-target issues
